handfixes.summary: doctor checks the composite ConnectWise auth (companyId+publicKey:privateKey Basic + clientId header)
handfixes.why: ConnectWise Manage needs composite Basic credentials PLUS a clientId header; the press's single-scheme auth model can't express this, so the doctor auth check is hand-wired to require all four. A reprint reverts doctor to the single-scheme check.

asserts.contains: Hand-wired: the generator's single-scheme model can't express

handfixes.summary: workload loads ONLY open tickets via cwLoadOpenTickets (SQL closedFlag prefilter), not the full history
handfixes.why: On a tenant with years of closed tickets (issue #146), cwLoad loaded every service-ticket row just to drop the closed ones in Go, pushing workload past its default timeout. cwLoadOpenTickets pushes the closedFlag filter into SQL so the working set scales with open-ticket count. A reprint reverts workload to cwLoad and drops cwLoadOpenTickets.

handfixes.summary: search auto mode bounds the live-API leg and falls back to local FTS on a timeout, not only on a network error
handfixes.why: On a large tenant (issue #146) the live POST /project/tickets/search leg holds the call open until the caller's deadline; auto mode only fell back to local on a network error, so a slow API hung the whole call. The leg is now capped (autoLiveSearchTimeout) and isTimeoutError joins isNetworkError in the fallback condition. A reprint reverts both.

handfixes.summary: MCP context tool query_tips teach the large-tenant playbook (conditions-scoped sync, local reads, --timeout) and note MCP search is local-only
handfixes.why: The escape hatches for a heavy tenant (--param conditions=, --data-source local, --timeout) existed in the binary but no agent-facing surface advertised them (issue #146). The query_tips block now teaches them. A reprint regenerates query_tips from the spec and drops these.

asserts.contains: Large/historical tenant: sync is a FULL re-fetch today
